t: Magnusson 930mm box beam level offers reliable and precise measurement for professional trade applications. Constructed from anodised aluminium, it provides a robust and durable tool whch is a valuable addition for any kit. Provides a high measuring accuracy of 0.5 mm/m, and features a magnetic V-groove base for stable, hands-free operation, ideal for plumbers and fabricators working with metal surfaces and pipes. Shock-resistant rubber end caps protect the level from impact, and 3 solid block vials (45°, 90°, 180°) ensure accurate horizontal and vertical angle finding. An ergonomic hand grip enhances user comfort and control.
